summary: Run timer per level with medal times as content (content/trial/<id>.json), the device's best time and medal per level, a timer panel, and TrialFinished at the line.
setup: List TrialClock in Game(systems=[...]) (from game.lib.time_trial import TrialClock).
Emit FinishReached() when the player crosses the line; with "auto_start": false in config/time_trial.json, emit TrialStarted() at the start (e.g. on countdown's CountdownFinished).

Optional: several trials per scene (e.g. per lap count): set ctx.get(TrialRun).variant before the line; records key on "<trial id>:<variant>" (trial_key). "show_timer": false in config/time_trial.json hides the timer panel for a game that draws its own clock.
